column2: [intro]
In my kitchen, there are spoons
That sing melodies in their own tunes
My fridge dances like a madman
With carrots and cabbages in a jam
I love the objects, they drive me wild (wild)
In my home, everywhere, everywhere (where, where)
They’re colorful, shiny, and wild (wild)
The objects, oh yeah, they drive me wild!
In my room, everything’s a mess
Socks dance rock’n’roll in a crazy fest
The phone talks to the pillow with cheer
And the posters wink, oh dear
I love the objects, they drive me wild (wild)
In my living room, everywhere, everywhere (where, where)
They’re funny, quirky, and wild (wild)
The objects, oh yeah, they drive me wild!
[ solo ]
I love the objects, they drive me wild (wild)
In my life, everywhere, everywhere (where, where)
They’re awesome, fantastic, and wild (wild)
The objects, oh yeah, they drive me wild!
[outro]
